# Harbor Valley Unified School District — Emergency Operations Plan (excerpt)

## Schools

The district operates Lincoln Elementary, Maple Grove Elementary School, Washington Middle School and Central High School. Each school keeps a site annex to this plan.

## Transportation annex

Buses on Bus Routes 14, 22 and 31 serve Lincoln Elementary and Washington Middle School. Route 40 serves Central High School. Bus 22 is the spare wheelchair-lift bus. Drivers report to dispatch by radio, and AVL shows every bus on the routing map.

## Access control

Exterior Doors 1–12 at Central High School are numbered from the main entrance clockwise. Door 7 is the cafeteria loading dock. Portable 4 and Wing B house the ninth-grade academy; Room 112 is the nurse's office.

## Family reunification

Primary reunification site: Riverside Community Church
Alternate reunification site: Harbor Valley Sports Complex

The Director of School Safety requests buses for relocation from the Director of Transportation. The district notifies the state education agency and the Department of Education's REMS TA Center contacts listed in Appendix C. Threat assessments follow the National Threat Assessment Center model.
